verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows no user-facing CLI. The pnpm commands (`pnpm go`, `pnpm nizzy env`, `pnpm db:studio`, `pnpm test:ai`) are repo development and self-hosting setup scripts, not an official CLI for operating the product. The documented MCP server belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
